subject: CoEvoShared+ | shared drafts as optional human projection, CoEvoDelta as machine intake, independent receiver readproof
target_surfaces: Existing authorized Gmail drafts (optional human editing/projection; no cross-account access assumed)
Private CoStead or successor custody when authorized (not presently proven)
Role-scoped CoSession subscription/CoPulse receiver packets (pickup unproven)
CoBar/CoOrb observer summary when implemented (runtime unproven)
contradictions: A Gmail draft may name an alternate mailbox in To/Cc without granting that account access to its unsent content.
The connected account is not proof of authorized access to any separately named mailbox; independent authenticated readback is missing.
A GitHub branch or PR is discoverable only to readers who actually retrieve it; it does not awaken idle sessions.
Draft edits lack guaranteed collision-safe merge; never last-writer-wins an actively edited shared draft.
tests: EXPECTED: public-safe machine delta validates against schemas/coevo-delta-v0.1.schema.json; exact schema check/CI pending after PR.
EXPECTED: authorized recipient independently retrieves the same hashed delta without human copy/paste; receiver readproof required.
EXPECTED: cross-account Gmail draft visibility is separately proven through account-specific authenticated access or delegated authorization, not inferred from To/Cc.
EXPECTED: one change creates a successor delta with old/new diff and receiver-specific currentness; no unreviewed overwrites.
NEGATIVE: private draft contents, addresses and third-party data never copied automatically into a public repository.
NEGATIVE: no email is sent and no external collaborator, AI session, or local worker is claimed to have received this packet.
expected_benefit: Reduce manual relay and duplicate work by preserving bounded incremental proposals, contradictions and successor links in a public-safe machine intake, with drafts as optional private human-readable views.
risks: False belief that Gmail Drafts are a cross-account shared folder
Leakage from private or sensitive working drafts into public GitHub
Unsolicited mass outreach or implicit permission inheritance
Another competing control plane or duplicate registry
wake_conditions: A qualified reader supplies independent exact-object receiver readproof
A verified authorized cross-account draft access/delegation route becomes available
A material collision, contradictory currentness, or privacy boundary requires review
One bounded CoTheoryAll or outreach draft evolves into a source-backed, consented successor
next_receiver: CoEvo domain-scoped reviewer via existing session bootstrap; no independent pickup or global broadcast claimed
